entries.coordinate_system: latitude/longitude supplied by the Android location provider
entries.ttl_policy: runtime_only; do not include personal location in shared source snapshots
entries.neihu_filter: B checks whether the local device position intersects the Neihu boundary.

verification.note: GNSS is produced by the phone and is not an online source for A.

entries.coverage: legacy roads and selected POIs within the Neihu administrative area
entries.update_frequency: community-maintained continuously; store versioned scheduled snapshots
entries.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL); attribution required
entries.ttl_policy: versioned_snapshot; refresh before each demo release
entries.neihu_filter: Use OSM relation 2905065 (admin_level=7) for collection, then validate geometries against the official Taipei Neihu boundary.

verification.result: The Neihu relation was found and an Overpass count query returned 5775 highway ways. This is a point-in-time count, not a completeness guarantee.

entries.coverage: Taiwan hospitals, clinics and shelters needed as POI/coordinate-support data; roads remain in the existing PMTiles basemap
entries.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL); attribution required
entries.ttl_policy: versioned_snapshot; refresh before a data release
entries.taiwan_filter: Use the Taiwan bbox query, then validate every geometry against the AreaCatalog union.

verification.note: The collector intentionally does not download a full Taiwan routing graph.

entries.coverage: Taiwan city/county live traffic accidents, construction, congestion, control, weather, disaster and abnormal events
entries.license: TDX terms of service and data licensing terms
entries.coordinate_system: event Positions or Geometry; normalize and validate as EPSG:4326
entries.ttl_policy: use ExpireTime when supplied; otherwise use source UpdateInterval or the default 900-second freshness TTL (TDX_EVENT_FRESHNESS_SECONDS)
entries.neihu_filter: Request City/Taipei, retain records whose Location.Address.Town or Location.CityRoad.Roadways[].Town is 內湖區, and use geometry intersection as the final check.
entries.taiwan_filter: Request the configured city/county endpoint list, retain all records whose WGS84 geometry intersects the AreaCatalog union, and mark partial endpoint failure in Raw metadata.

verification.result: The official OAS confirms the endpoint, Taipei city code, Town fields and OAuth2 client-credentials flow. An unauthenticated minimal request returned HTTP 401.

entries.coverage: nationwide significant felt-earthquake reports and observed intensity areas
entries.license: CWA Open Weather Data Platform terms
entries.coordinate_system: EPSG:4326 for epicenter and station coordinates
entries.ttl_policy: retain as an immutable event report; version by EarthquakeNo and IssueTime
entries.neihu_filter: Keep reports that contain a Taipei City intensity area or an observation point intersecting Neihu. If only city-level intensity exists, label coverage_level=city and do not claim district precision.
entries.taiwan_filter: Keep all records whose observation/epicenter geometry or affected administrative area resolves to the AreaCatalog.

verification.result: The official dataset exposes earthquake number, origin time, epicenter, magnitude and county or station intensity fields.

entries.coverage: current weather warnings organized mainly by county or city
entries.license: CWA Open Weather Data Platform terms
entries.coordinate_system: administrative-area warning; no point coordinate required
entries.ttl_policy: use warning effective and end times; replace or cancel by message update
entries.neihu_filter: Select 臺北市 warnings. Treat them as city-scope warnings applicable to Neihu, not as Neihu-specific observations.
entries.taiwan_filter: Retain all county/city warnings and preserve coverage_level=area or city when no point geometry is provided.

verification.result: W-C0033-001 is explicitly designed around county or city areas. W-C0033-002 can supplement event content and affected areas.

entries.coverage: nationwide multi-agency warnings, including flood, rainfall, debris-flow and large-landslide alerts
entries.update_frequency: depends on the selected NCDR datastore; retain retrieved_at and source update fields
entries.license: NCDR platform terms or source-agency license; record per resource
entries.coordinate_system: CAP polygon, circle or point; normalize to EPSG:4326
entries.ttl_policy: use CAP sent, effective, onset and expires fields; preserve cancel and update messages
entries.neihu_filter: Legacy fixture compatibility only; the first-stage collector uses Taiwan scope and AreaCatalog.
entries.taiwan_filter: Prefer CAP polygons or administrative geocodes resolved through AreaCatalog. Keep citizen reports in an unverified namespace.

verification.result: The official API returns a capid index from /api/datastore and a complete CAP document from /api/dump/datastore. A local Taiwan smoke run retrieved 196 details, normalized 196 events, resolved 21 counties and kept the API key out of Raw.

demo_policy.disclaimer: Replay disaster events are fictional and must not be presented as current NCDR alerts.

related_resources.auth: The page describes an open KMZ API, but the concrete endpoint still needs onboarding confirmation.

entries.coverage: nationwide shelter points with coordinates, capacity and supported disaster types
entries.license: 政府資料開放授權條款第1版
entries.coordinate_system: longitude and latitude; validate as EPSG:4326
entries.ttl_policy: versioned_snapshot; retain retrieval and source modification timestamps
entries.neihu_filter: Filter 縣市及鄉鎮市區=臺北市內湖區 and validate coordinates against the Neihu polygon.

verification.result: The national point CSV contains multiple Neihu shelters with coordinates. The Taipei 114 list separately returned 38 Neihu rows, but that list lacks coordinates and must not be treated as live opening status.

entries.coverage: Taipei hospitals with name, address and coordinates
entries.ttl_policy: versioned_snapshot; refresh when the source publishes a new list
entries.neihu_filter: Filter addresses containing 臺北市內湖區, then validate coordinates against the Neihu polygon.

verification.result: The current hospital resource returned 4 records whose addresses contain 內湖區.

entries.coverage: Taiwan shelter points with address, capacity, disaster types and coordinates
entries.license: 政府資料開放授權條款第1版
entries.coordinate_system: EPSG:4326 coordinates supplied by the source; validate before use
entries.ttl_policy: versioned_snapshot; signed static layer manifest is valid for 30 days after publication
entries.taiwan_filter: No Neihu text filter; retain records inside the AreaCatalog union and preserve unresolved source values as null.

verification.note: The collector publishes static locations and planned capacity; it does not publish current opening status.

entries.coverage: Taiwan medical institution master records with name, phone, county/town, address, department and staffing fields
entries.license: 政府資料開放授權條款第1版
entries.coordinate_system: No coordinates in the master; supplement only from validated NLSC/OSM point matches
entries.ttl_policy: versioned_snapshot; signed static layer manifest is valid for 30 days after publication; unresolved records remain in the report and are not drawn as points
entries.taiwan_filter: No Neihu filter; retain all nationwide records and add county_code/town_code/area_id when resolved.

verification.note: The collector parses content.xml from the official ODS ZIP and keeps records without inventing coordinates.

entries.format: CSV tile catalogue and linked DTM files
entries.coverage: Taiwan 20-meter DTM; select tiles intersecting Neihu
entries.license: 政府資料開放授權條款第1版
entries.coordinate_system: source-specific projected coordinates; inspect tile metadata before conversion
entries.neihu_filter: Select tiles intersecting the official Neihu boundary and clip after coordinate conversion. A 100-meter DEM/DSM source is available as a fallback when DSM is required.

verification.result: The 2025 catalogue provides 20-meter DTM elevation data; it is not a live API and does not itself provide slope or isolation risk.

entries.coverage: 4G and 5G base-station licence counts by township or district
entries.license: 政府資料開放授權條款第1版
entries.ttl_policy: retain latest statistical period and historical snapshots
entries.neihu_filter: Filter 縣市=臺北市 and 鄉鎮區=臺北市內湖區.

verification.result: The latest verified period 1150831 contains Neihu values for 4G and 5G. This source is only an infrastructure-count proxy, not a coverage or outage map.

entries.format: STAC JSON metadata and linked Sentinel assets
entries.coverage: Sentinel-1 GRD SAR and Sentinel-2 L2A optical scenes intersecting Neihu
entries.license: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem data terms; preserve product attribution
entries.coordinate_system: EPSG:4326 bbox or GeoJSON geometry for catalogue search
entries.ttl_policy: immutable scene metadata and asset checksum; create new snapshots for new acquisitions
entries.neihu_filter: Search by Neihu bbox [121.5519933,25.0518603,121.6286149,25.1151519], date range and collection; clip or mask assets to the official polygon after download.

verification.result: The official STAC search returned Sentinel-1 GRD and Sentinel-2 L2A scenes intersecting the Neihu bbox for the tested 2026-08-01 to 2026-09-04 interval. Imagery classification is not part of A's collector.
